evidence.name: Screen field: Show an image or video
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Show an image or video" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Show an image or video
sections.description: Turns the image or video block on or off for this screen; off means no visual is shown. Turn it on to add a supporting visual, since on a paid landing page a relevant image or video builds trust and lifts conversion. When enabled, it starts with sensible styling from your design theme that you can fine-tune in the fields below.
